cim: World Models Are Coming for the Physical World
cim_eredeti: World Models Are Coming for the Physical World
szoveg_eredeti:
Learn more about Praxis-1 world action model: https://runway.com/research/introducing-praxis-1

Inside Runway’s robotics research, where video models become physical AI. Traditional robots follow preprogrammed trajectories and fail the moment the world changes. This episode looks at Praxis-1 and how a world action model uses visual observations from a robot’s cameras to reason about what happens next, folding a T-shirt by responding to how the fabric actually deforms. From household assistants to handling returns and agriculture, the repetitive work robots could take on, and why human judgment still sets the constraints and verifies the outputs.
